content:
Hey everyone! My name is Philip Weiss and I'm a software engineer at Netflix and former CS graduate student. I worked with Lean back in my college (~2018) days and have had an interest in formalization of mathematics for a long time.

I've been working on a project related to AI and Math (https://theoremdb.org/), and I'm looking forward to learning more about the Lean community today and where people are focusing their efforts.
